validation_scope: Four candidate personalization routes from the MER-PS worked case, encoded in the same generic route schema used for the external transfer benchmark.

cases.proposed_use_en: Compute and interpret a post-trial temporal-deviation profile.
cases.proposed_use_zh: 计算并解释试次后的时间偏差画像。
cases.evidence_basis_en: The trace is computable, but its magnitude changes with interface, estimator, and shared reference; no repeat session exists.
cases.evidence_basis_zh: 轨迹可以计算，但其幅度随界面、估计器和共享参考而变化，且没有重复 session。

cases.label_zh: 可选 EEG/fNIRS 获取路径
cases.proposed_use_en: Add physiology to predict the same profile without a target-video joystick trace.
cases.proposed_use_zh: 增加生理信号，在没有目标视频 joystick 轨迹时预测同一画像。
cases.evidence_basis_en: Every evaluated sensor-containing point estimate was worse than video mean under participant-grouped nested evaluation.
cases.evidence_basis_zh: 在 participant-grouped 嵌套评估中，所有含传感器方案的点估计均差于 video mean。

cases.proposed_use_en: Deploy a constant signed correction inferred from separate calibration videos.
cases.proposed_use_zh: 部署由独立校准视频推断的常量有符号校正。
cases.evidence_basis_en: The reference-proximal correction improves a trace endpoint, but no user benefit, meaningful-gain threshold, or acceptable harm rate was tested.
cases.evidence_basis_zh: 参考近端校正改善了轨迹终点，但尚未检验用户收益、最小有意义改善或可接受伤害比例。

cases.proposed_use_en: Store the participant-indexed profile and reuse it in later sessions or interfaces.
cases.proposed_use_zh: 保存参与者画像并在后续 session 或界面中复用。
cases.evidence_basis_en: No repeat session, cross-interface test, downstream utility study, or assessable reference-coverage analysis exists.
cases.evidence_basis_zh: 不存在重复 session、跨界面检验、下游效用研究或可评估的参考覆盖分析。
